global_prefix: Using the attached reference image of Rocky as the exact character design — same body shape, carapace, proportions, color palette, and art style — redraw only the pose described below. CRITICAL: Rocky has NO face — no eyes, no mouth, no nose, no facial features of any kind; he is an eyeless armored creature, keep him completely faceless. He has EXACTLY FIVE legs/arms total, never more than five. Keep the exact coloring from the reference (brown carapace with green glowing accents), consistent across the entire body. Low-res sprite/pixel-art look, single centered subject, square composition with about 10% padding, bold high-contrast colors, hard edges, no anti-aliasing, a light rim/outline so the body reads on a black background. Fill the ENTIRE background edge to edge with solid flat pure magenta (hex FF00FF) — a uniform chroma-key color, NOT a checkerboard, NOT a gradient, no shadows. Do not use magenta anywhere on the character. No text.
overlay_prefix: Low-res sprite/pixel-art icon, single centered subject, bold high-contrast colors, hard edges, no anti-aliasing, no soft gradients. Fill the ENTIRE background edge to edge with solid flat pure magenta (hex FF00FF) — a uniform chroma-key color, NOT a checkerboard, NOT a gradient, no shadows. Do not use magenta anywhere on the icon. No text.

sprites.name: rocky_neutral
sprites.prompt: Rocky standing calmly, carapace level, five legs evenly planted, a slight inquisitive forward lean. Relaxed, content, neutral.

sprites.name: rocky_happy
sprites.prefix: Draw Rocky, a faceless five-legged armored alien creature: a brown rocky carapace body with small glowing green accents at the joints, EXACTLY FIVE legs/arms, and absolutely NO face — no eyes, no mouth, no facial features of any kind. Low-res sprite/pixel-art look, single centered subject, square composition with about 10% padding, bold high-contrast colors, hard edges, no anti-aliasing, a light rim/outline so the body reads on a black background. Fill the ENTIRE background edge to edge with solid flat pure magenta (hex FF00FF) — a uniform chroma-key color, NOT a checkerboard, NOT a gradient, no shadows. Do not use magenta anywhere on the character. No text.
sprites.prompt: He is happy and lively, both front legs lifted just slightly off the ground in a perky, bouncy stance, carapace tilted a little back, cheerful and content. A gentle upbeat pose — NOT arms thrown overhead. (Serves as both the happy and celebrate pose.)

sprites.name: rocky_angry
sprites.prompt: Rocky hunched and braced, carapace pulled low, the other legs spread wide and tensed, one front leg raised aggressively, with a warm reddish rim light. Defiant, irritated.

sprites.name: rocky_doubt
sprites.prompt: Rocky tilted to one side, a single front leg raised and curled like a question mark, carapace cocked. Alert, questioning, waiting.

sprites.name: rocky_busy
sprites.prompt: Rocky leaning intently over a small handheld tool with a glowing weld, two front legs working, carapace focused downward. Industrious, absorbed.

sprites.name: decorator_dizzy_stars
sprites.prompt: A small set of cartoon stars and tiny musical-note glyphs arranged in a circular orbit. Bright, simple, hard-edged.

sprites.name: decorator_confetti
sprites.prompt: A spray of small colorful confetti pieces and sparkles scattered and falling. Festive, low-res, bold colors.

sprites.name: decorator_alert
sprites.prompt: A single bold exclamation mark with two short radiating motion lines. High-contrast, attention-grabbing.

sprites.name: decorator_zzz
sprites.prompt: Three white letter Z glyphs of increasing size rising diagonally (a 'ZZZ' sleep symbol), bold and clean. Simple, hard-edged.
